This '''unknown executive''' was the president of the second largest [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belthu]]. This president was a supporter of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and supplied him regularly with refined [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]].<ref name="WS" />

During [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller's'']] visit to Belthu, the president informed a disguised [[Garik Loran]] that the next batch of durasteel was ready for taking. The location of the shipment was passed to [[New Republic Intelligence Service]].<ref name="WS" />
